result.summary: The page is largely well-rendered, but horizontally scrolling content is visibly clipped at the right edge and lower content is partially obscured by the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The horizontal category and “Fastest near you” carousels extend beyond the right screen edge. The next category chip and the Trattoria Piccolo card are visibly cut off, including truncated restaurant text.
issues.suggestion: Implement a clearly bounded horizontal carousel with consistent side padding and intentional partial-card affordance, or ensure complete cards/text remain visible within the viewport.

issues.description: The next Popular right now restaurant card is covered by the fixed bottom navigation area, leaving its content inaccessible until the user scrolls further.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to or greater than the bottom navigation height so the final visible card clears the navigation.

issues.description: The horizontal chip row is clipped at the right boundary with no visible fade, spacing, or other cue that it is horizontally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add an edge fade/gradient, improve trailing spacing, or otherwise communicate horizontal scrolling while avoiding abrupt clipping.
